about.title: AI connected to the reality of those who use it.
paragraphs: ACT AI develops solutions for the healthcare sector with proprietary artificial intelligence models, taking into account regulatory requirements and operational challenges.
This purpose takes shape in the Input Manager: a solution to improve information quality and help hospitals reduce waste.

marco.name: Marco Spinelli
marco.title: Founder & CEO
marco.bio: 25+ years of global leadership, executive management and product development in financial services, launching award-winning AI/LLM applications, data strategies and digital transformation. Held senior positions at McKinsey & Co, Morgan Stanley, UBS and Bridgewater in New York, London and Paris. Advised Fortune 500 CEOs, Central Bankers and Investment Management leaders on innovation and AI strategy. Served on the Board of Touch Health (NY), actively contributing to the development of the healthcare system in East Africa. MBA from Wharton and a BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering from University of São Paulo.

mauricio.name: Maurício Lima
mauricio.title: Co-Founder
mauricio.bio: 20+ years in VC and PE. Raised over US$380 million, led 27 investments and 14 exits achieving an average annual return of 30.3% and a multiple of over 4x CoC. Co-founder and CEO of Henkan Investimentos Ltda. Founder of Brazil’s largest B2B tech investment firm, Invest Tech. Current Chairman of Quality Digital and Board Member at SkyOne. Held senior positions at Latinvest, Lloyds Bank, and Banco Itaú. BA from Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV)

vera.name: Vera Valente
vera.bio: Executive with nearly 30 years of experience in the healthcare sector. At Brazil's Ministry of Health, she led the National Health Card (Cartão SUS) project, from technical design to the start of implementation; at ANVISA, as General Manager of Generics, she helped structure that market in the country. She was the first president of Pró-Genéricos, CEO of Quintiles in Brazil and executive director of FenaSaúde (2019–2025), where she led the national campaign against fraud in private health insurance. An IBGC-trained board member, she is a member of WCD and co-author of "Mulheres no Conselho".

yen.name: Yen Wang
yen.bio: 30+ years of experience in leadership and strategy consulting, including 18 years in senior management roles at large multinationals in Latin America. CEO of Emeis Group in Latin America, in the healthcare sector, and CEO of BSL Saúde. Previously CEO of Carrefour Property in Brazil and Director of Corporate Strategy and New Business at Oi. Career includes 15 years of consulting at McKinsey, A.T. Kearney and Arthur D. Little, serving companies across different markets. Brings international experience in strategy, business development, operations transformation and team management, including five years working in China. Computer Science degree from Universidade de São Paulo.

gustavo.name: Gustavo Jobim
gustavo.bio: Entrepreneur and seasoned independent director with a 30+ year track record in tech/finance. Founded Microcomp (Novell Networks integrator and software development), Nexus (Tech Credit for SMEs), Taggy (Payment Technologies) and Vixtra (international trade and finance); and co-founded GPS Investimentos (Brazil’s largest independent asset manager, acquired by Julius Baer in 2011). Former Goldman Sachs VP. Has served on 15 boards and 22 strategic committees globally, including Wharton’s Executive Board, Suzano, Positivo Tecnologia, Ticket‑Edenred and FGC (Brazil’s Credit Guarantee Fund). Business Degree from Universidade de São Paulo (honors) and a Wharton MBA in Finance and Entrepreneurship.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We accelerate the adoption of AI tools in Emerging Markets and underserved Developed Markets by delivering tailored, real-world solutions.
mission.problemText: Most pre-trained AI models evolve from English language/context data, leaving entire regions under-represented. This is particularly acute in specialty and highly regulated sectors, such as Finance, Health Care and Legal
mission.differenceText: ACT.AI focuses on adapting AI to local realities — from language and infrastructure to business needs. We provide high-quality labeled data, train models in underrepresented languages, and develop scalable B2B applications for regions often overlooked
